name: Pad Synth
shortDescription: A playable glowing synth grid with a step ring and loops you keep.
description: A touch instrument for phones, tablets, and desktops. Play an isomorphic grid of pads in any scale and key with four voices: a Karplus–Strong pluck, a wide detuned-saw pad, a bass with a sub, and FM electric keys. Every press sends a wave of colored light across a full-screen field, so a chord draws its own interference pattern; an oscilloscope and a spectrum run across the top, and the pad voice's slow attack and long release rise and fade in the glow. A step ring with a comet playhead plays a pattern under you, Split gives two people one half each, and Record keeps what you play as a loop rendered to WAV. Loops and patches stay on your device and save as WAV and JSON files. Desktops play from the keyboard too.
setup: Your agent asks, in one message, which scale and key you like to play in, how big a grid you want (5 by 8 or 6 by 10 pads), what tempo the step ring should run at, and which look you want: aurora, ember, or ink. No keys or accounts are needed. Your loops and patches stay in your browser on your device, and you save them as WAV and JSON files when you want them.
